sharedMapEvidence: Not applicable — there is no register map to share. These models are grouped because none of them contains electronics of any kind, not because a source shows matching addresses. No model in this group may later be promoted onto a communicating dialect without a source showing an actual electrical interface, which none currently does.
gotchas: There is nothing to talk to. Kinetic Solar manufactures structural aluminium and stainless racking, mounting and flashing only. No product in the line has a port, a radio, a controller, or a power connection. No protocol document exists because no protocol exists. Tier D — recorded so nobody researches it twice.

The brand-wall listings at cabin-depot, ecosolaris and solacity carried no model numbers not because the distributors withhold them but because the SKUs are hardware part numbers (KEC30-M, KJS2-M, KRAPID1) with ratings expressed in millimetres and feet, not volts and amps. The absent model list was correct information,

KAGMM-G is named a "micro-inverter mount" and will surface in searches for inverter hardware. It is an $7.35 steel bracket that holds somebody else's micro-inverter onto a Hat Rail. It is not an inverter and reports nothing. Do not let the name pull this vendor into the inverter category on a future sweep.

Kinetic Solar racking is genuinely relevant to one thing in this system: the ground mount K3AGM-G has a 0-60 degree adjustable tilt, and the tilt actually set is an input the `forecast` device needs.
